correctness.rationale: Exact multinomial indicator joint-moment formula derived for all n, an explicit homogeneous polynomial identity produces an all-parameter nonnegative certificate for every profile of support at most four, with strictness for two or more positive species. Exact five-species rational witness covariance is \(1/800\); continuity gives all larger supports. A two-species model is negative for every \(n\ge 2\); a one-common plus L-rare family converges in joint moments to strictly positive \(n a^2(1-a)^n[1-(1-a)^{n-1}]\), giving finite positive examples for each fixed \(n\ge 2\). The separate Poissonized identity has correct negative sign. Reproducible checker passed 984 exact enumeration, polynomial coefficient, and limit checks; finite tests are not substituted for infinite proofs.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete minimal-support classification of correlation between the actual unobserved biodiversity mass and its conventional singleton-based predictor, with a strong general-n extension and a Poissonization contrast. It identifies a precise finite-sample limitation of intuitive calibration from rare-frequency counts, in the same ecological sample-completeness setting of Chao and Jost (2012). The claim is neither an arbitrary numerical threshold nor a routine restatement of a known expectation identity; it requires an all-profiles four-variable positivity identity and a nondegenerate rare-tail construction. This does not assert estimator efficiency or ecological field validity.
